description: Implementation of quic_connection_context class and thread-local context management for different platforms (STARBOARD and non-STARBOARD).

classes.name: QuicConnectionContext
classes.description: Represents the context for a QUIC connection, with thread-local access.

classes.name: QuicConnectionProcessPacketContext
classes.description: Holds information about packet processing, including payload and offset.

classes.name: QuicConnectionContextSwitcher
classes.description: Manages switching of the current connection context, activating and deactivating tracers.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the packet processing context, including payload size and hexdump.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current QuicConnectionContext based on platform-specific thread-local storage.

methods.name: QuicConnectionContextSwitcher
methods.description: Constructor that switches the current context to a new one and activates its tracer.

methods.name: ~QuicConnectionContextSwitcher
methods.description: Destructor that restores the previous context and deactivates the tracer.
